metaShifts.description: The introduction of Innates and Facets fundamentally restructures hero power curves and customization. Every hero gains passive effects from level 1 (Innates) and strategic customization options (Facets), creating unprecedented early-game impact variance and match-specific optimization potential. This represents the largest mechanical overhaul in Dota 2 history.

metaShifts.theme: Status Resistance to Slow Resistance Paradigm Shift
metaShifts.description: Sange items lose Status Resistance (-16%) but gain Slow Resistance (+20%), fundamentally changing defensive itemization priorities. This amplifies the previous patch's utility cooldown inflation by making heroes more vulnerable to disables while providing better mobility against slows. The meta shifts from disable mitigation to positioning-based defense.

Building on 7.35d's intelligence item nerfs, this patch increases costs across the board: Eternal Shroud (+100g), Kaya/Sange/Yasha (+100g each), all combinations (+200g). Combined with Octarine Core stat nerfs (-75 HP/Mana), this continues the systematic dismantling of spell-based itemization efficiency.

Banner transforms from a global pushing tool to a localized invulnerability field (600 radius, 2min duration). This creates concentrated teamfight advantages rather than map-wide pressure, fundamentally changing late-game objective control from split-push enablement to grouped engagement dominance.

synergisticWinners.entity: Tinker + March of the Machines Return
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Tinker's Heat-Seeking Missile replacement with March of the Machines, combined with Rearm no longer resetting item cooldowns, creates a hero focused purely on spell-based area control. The +310 base movement speed buff compensates for reduced mobility, while the new ability synergizes with his innate spell-focused identity.

The shift from Status Resistance to Slow Resistance (+20% on Sange, +25% on combinations) creates powerful synergy with heroes who rely on positioning and mobility. Heroes like Storm Spirit, Queen of Pain, and Puck benefit enormously from slow immunity while maintaining their natural disable avoidance through positioning.

PA's Blur losing evasion but gaining untargetability with ghostly visibility creates synergy with aggressive positioning items. Combined with +2 base damage and +10 attack speed, she becomes a positioning-based assassin rather than an evasion tank, synergizing with Blink Dagger and initiation items.

Converting Timbersaw to Strength (+19 base damage) while maintaining his spell-based kit creates synergy with Strength-based items like Sange combinations. His new stat scaling allows him to build tanky items while retaining spell damage, creating a unique hybrid scaling pattern.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Counterspell losing spell reflection by default, combined with +5 mana cost on Blink and Counterspell, creates negative synergy with AM's mana-dependent playstyle. The hero becomes less effective at both farming (higher mana costs) and teamfighting (no spell reflection), while talent reworks remove key scaling options.

The systematic cost increases across intelligence items (Kaya +100g, Octarine -75 stats, Eternal Shroud +100g) create negative synergy with spell-dependent heroes. This continues 7.35d's intelligence item nerfs, making heroes like Invoker, Storm Spirit, and Leshrac significantly more expensive to itemize effectively.

Burrow losing specific ability bonuses (Impale range/cooldown, Mind Flare range) but gaining generic +500 cast range creates negative synergy with Nyx's assassination playstyle. The hero loses specialized ganking tools in favor of generic improvements, reducing his unique strategic identity.

Dragon Lance losing disassembly creates negative synergy with flexible itemization strategies. Ranged cores can no longer use it as a temporary positioning tool before breaking it down for other items, reducing build path flexibility and forcing more committed item choices.

Carry.explanation: Blur rework removes evasion dependency while adding untargetability mechanics, creating a positioning-based carry. +2 base damage and +10 attack speed provide early game presence, while the new Blur allows for aggressive positioning without relying on RNG evasion.

Metamorphosis range scaling (450/490/530/570) and Demon Zeal adding +20 HP regen create better farming patterns. The hero benefits from Sange item changes (slow resistance) while maintaining strong illusion scaling through the new systems.

Mid.explanation: March of the Machines return with +310 base movement speed creates a spell-focused mid laner. Rearm no longer resetting items forces pure spell-based gameplay, while the movement speed buff enables better positioning for March usage and escape.

+3 base armor and Dream Coil buffs (+25 damage, +0.1s stun) create stronger teamfight presence. The hero benefits from Sange slow resistance changes while maintaining natural disable immunity through Phase Shift.

Offlane.explanation: Strength hero conversion provides +19 base damage while maintaining spell-based scaling. The hero can now build Sange items for slow resistance while benefiting from Strength-based survivability, creating a unique hybrid scaling pattern.

Despite base stat nerfs, the Mount ability gaining invulnerability for the target creates powerful save potential. Combined with Innate abilities, Centaur becomes a more strategic offlaner focused on team utility rather than raw stats.

SoftSupport.explanation: Stroke of Fate applying Ink Trail on hit creates better harassment and setup potential. The hero's spell-based kit benefits from the new Facet system while maintaining strong teamfight control through improved ability interactions.

Icarus Dive damage increase (+5 per level) and cooldown improvements create better trading patterns. The hero's percentage-based damage scaling works well with the new Innate system while maintaining strong teamfight presence.

HardSupport.explanation: Frostbite dealing 4x damage to creeps creates reliable farming/stacking potential despite losing bonus duration. Freezing Field attack speed slow buffs (80/120/160) provide stronger teamfight control, while Innate abilities enhance her aura impact.

Maledict instant first tick and improved damage scaling create stronger laning presence. The ability to immediately apply damage makes trading more effective, while radius increases improve teamfight impact.

Carry.explanation: Counterspell losing spell reflection by default removes key teamfight utility. +5 mana cost on Blink and Counterspell creates farming inefficiency, while talent reworks remove scaling options. The hero becomes less effective at both farming and fighting.

Moon Glaives bounce reduction (3/4/5/6 to 2/3/4/5) and active version nerfs (4 to 3 glaives, +50 mana cost) reduce farming efficiency. The hero loses reliable AoE damage while facing increased mana constraints.

Mid.explanation: Despite spell cooldown buffs, the hero suffers from intelligence item cost inflation. Wex losing cooldown reduction removes a key scaling mechanic, while expensive itemization makes the hero less viable in faster-paced games.

Arcane Orb mana scaling nerf (12/13/14/15% to 10/11/12/13%) reduces damage output. Combined with base movement speed (-5) and armor (-0.5) nerfs, the hero becomes less effective at both farming and fighting.

Offlane.explanation: Berserker's Call armor nerf (16/19/22/25 to 14/16/18/20) reduces survivability during initiation. Aghanim's upgrades being shuffled between Shard/Scepter creates itemization confusion without providing clear power increases.

-8 base damage significantly impacts laning phase trading. Viscous Nasal Goo Shard losing stack limit increases reduces late-game scaling potential, while the hero faces increased competition from reworked offlaners.

SoftSupport.explanation: Thunder Strike losing Kinetic Field interactions by default removes combo potential. Kinetic Field cooldown increase (20/17/14/11s to 20/18/16/14s) reduces area control frequency, while Shard nerfs limit scaling options.

Burrow losing specific ability bonuses (Impale range/cooldown, Mind Flare range) in favor of generic improvements reduces assassination potential. Mind Flare cooldown increases make the hero less effective at burst damage.

HardSupport.explanation: Mana Drain losing damage by default removes harassment potential. Despite stat gain buffs, the hero loses a key laning tool while facing increased competition from supports with better Innate/Facet scaling.

Systematic nerfs across all abilities: Upheaval mana cost increase (+30), Chaotic Offering damage reduction, and Golem nerfs. The hero loses teamfight impact while facing longer cooldowns and higher mana costs.
